sn22.77:1.5: yad anattā taṃ netaṃ mama neso ham asmi na me so attā ti || || Evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ || || 4-7
sn22.77:2.1: Vedanā- -daṭṭhabbaṃ || || 8 Evam passaṃ bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako rūpasmim pi nibbindati || vedanāya pi || saññāya pi || saṅkhāresu pi || viññānasmim pi nibbindati || || 9
sn22.77:2.2: Nibbindaṃ virajjati virāgā vimuccati vimuttasmiṃ vimuttam iti ñāṇaṃ hoti || ||
sn22.77:2.3: Khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparam itthattāyāti pajānāti || || 10
sn22.77:2.4: Yāvatā bhikkhave sattāvāsā yāvatā bhavaggam ete aggā ete seṭṭhā lokasmiṃ yad idam arahanto ti || || 1-2 Sāvatthi || ||
